_about: BOSSPHASE v1 (laneTOP20B, BossPhase.cs, UNPROVEN IN UNITY). The half-HP phase of a boss as a readable tell. The phase itself is AiAdapt's enrage (ai_adapt.json profiles[].enrage: hpFrac, speedMul, waitMul, reactionMul, comboAdd, punishAdd, diversify, fx): this file adds what the player can SEE and HEAR when it starts, and an optional damage step. A row fires once when the boss enters its phase (AIBrain.adapt.enraged turns true; a fighter with no AiAdapt profile falls back to health / maxHealth <= the row hpFrac). rows[].id = roster id (RosterResolver; '*' = any enemy). cue = an EXISTING cue name from audio_manifest.json played through CueBus (gain 0 = silent, rate < 1 = deeper: effort_voice at 0.45 to 0.85 is the roar; no new audio). shake = a camera_impact.json shake class id ('special', 'crit', 'deathblow', 'hitHeavy', 'guardBreak', '' = none) x shakeMul. damageMul multiplies DuelFighter.damageScale while the phase is on (1.0 = no change, and 1.0 ships on every row: raise it only after a -balanceauto run). Nothing here adds a move, clip, weapon or texture; Grendel stays claws only, Erlking unarmed. MASTER enabled ships false = no BossPhase object, today's behaviour byte for byte. | BOSSPHASES v1 (13 Nov): rows now roar with charge_foe (two 0.4 s growls, in audio_manifest, was unused for the phase) and shake with hitHeavy / deathblow classes (special amp 0.03 m was barely visible). LIVE keys: cue, shake, shakeMul, damageMul. INERT keys (JsonUtility ignores them until BossPhase.Enter reads them, see PLAN.md code list C1..C4): slowMo, stagger{}, flash{}, telegraph{}, summon[]. Phase threshold = ai_adapt.json enrage.hpFrac (hpFrac here is only the no-profile fallback).

rows._note: Gate Warden, tutorial: mild roar, short recoil, NO summon, NO damage step. Signature belly_grab gets hungrier (belly_bite.json phase2).
River Tyrant: phase fires at 0.6 (ai_adapt, SOBEKBAL). Optional summon = the existing burrow croc fodder (z2_burrow_croc, hpMul 0.2) forced up beside the lane.
Bone Reaver: phase 0.6 (clone of sobek_hunter, ai_adapt). Optional summon = ONE existing bandit spawn row.
Cedar guardian: the roar is the forest answering (humbaba_watch groan is separate). No summon: the falling branch is his adds.
Final boss: loudest tell, longest beat. The roar also unlocks his DEATHBLOW (posture.json deathblowMinHealthFrac 0.4 -> 0.5).
